senses.gloss: शंव , शंवर, शंवूक. See शम्ब, शम्बर, शम्बूक, p. 1055.
शंव See शम्ब, p. 1055, col. 2.
सं-√ 2. वा P. -वाति, to blow at the same time, blow, TBr.; MBh.
शं॑—वत् (शं॑-), mfn. auspicious, prosperous, ŚBr.
containing the word शम्, Cat.
1. सं-व॑त् f. (fr. 2. सम्; cf. नि-व॑त्, प्र-व॑त्) a side, region, tract, RV.; AV.
= संग्राम, Naigh. ii, 17.

2. सं-वत् ind. (a contraction of सं-वत्सर below) a year, in the year (in later times esp. of the Vikrama era [beginning in 58 B.C. See विक्रमादित्य] as opp. to the Śaka era [in modern times supposed to be founded by Śāli-vāhana; see 3. शक]; sometimes = ‘in the year of the reign of’), Inscr. &c., IW. 494.
3. सं-वत् mfn. containing the word सम्, ŚāṅkhBr.
सं-वत् n. N. of a Sāman, PañcavBr.
शं—वद m., Pāṇ. iii, 2, 14, Sch.
सं-वाद॑ m. (ifc. f(आ). ) speaking together, conversation, colloquy with (instr. with and without सह loc., or comp.), RV. &c. &c.
appointment, stipulation, KātyŚr.; Kāv.; VarBṛS.
a cause, lawsuit, ĀpGṛ.; Kathās.
assent, concurrence, agreement, conformity, similarity, W.
information, news, ib.
शांवत्य m. (fr. शं-वत्) N. of an ancient teacher, ĀśvGṛ.
सं-वंह्. See सम्-√ बंह्.
सं-वा॑च् f. speaking together, colloquy, RV.
सं-˚वाच्य n. (prob.) the art of conversation (as one of the 64 Kalās), BhP., Sch.
सं-˚वाच्य mfn. to be conversed with &c., MW.
सं-√ वञ्च् P. -वञ्चति, to totter, stagger, waver, TS.
सं-व॑त्सम् ind. for a year, RV. iv, 33, 4.

सं-वत्सर॑ m. (rarely n.; cf. परि-व्˚) a full year, a year (having 12 [TS.] or 13 [VS.] months or 360 days [ŚBr.; AitBr.; Suśr.]; अम्, ‘for a year’; एण ‘after or in course of a y˚’; ए or अस्य, ‘after or within a y˚’), RV. &c. &c.
a year of the Vikrama era (see above; वर्ष is used for the शक) the first in a cycle of five or six years, TS.; PārGṛ.; VarBṛS.; BhP.
the Year personified (having the new and full moon for eyes and presiding over the seasons), TS.; Pur.
N. of Śiva, MBh.
सांवत्सर mf(ई)n. (fr. सं-वत्सर) yearly, annual, perennial, lasting or occupying year (with भृति, f., ‘annual wages’), ŚrS.; MBh.; BhP.
सांवत्सर m. an astrologer, almanac-maker, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a lunar month, L.
black rice, L.
(with दीक्षित) N. of an author, Cat.
सं-वत्सर—कर m. ‘year-causer’, N. of Śiva, Śivag.
सं-वत्सर—कल्प-लता f.
सं-वत्सर—कृत्य n. (or -दिधिति f.) N. of wk.
सं-वत्सर—कृत्य—दीधिति f. N. of wk.
सं-वत्सर—कृत्य-प्रकाश m. N. of wk.
सं-वत्सर—कौमुदी f. N. of wk.
सं-वत्सर—कौस्तुभ m. N. of wk.
सं-वत्सर—तम mf(ई)n. completing a full year, happening after a y˚ (-तमीं॑ रा॑त्रिम्, ‘this day year’), ŚBr.
सं-वत्सर—दीक्ष mfn. having the Dīkṣā (q.v.) maintained for a y˚, KātyŚr.
सं-वत्सर—दीक्षित mfn. maintaining the Dīkṣā for a year, ib.
सं-वत्सर—दीधिति f. See -कृत्य.
सं-वत्सर—दीप-माहात्म्य n. N. of wk.
सं-वत्सर—दीप-व्रत-माहात्म्य n. N. of wk.
सं-वत्सर—निरोध m. imprisonment for a y˚ (-तस् ind.), Mn. viii, 375.
सं-वत्सर—निरोध—तस् ind.
सं-वत्सर—पर्वन् n. the period of a y˚, Pat. on Pāṇ. iv, 2, 21, Vārtt. 2.
सं-वत्सर—प्रकरण n. N. of wk.
सं-वत्सर—प्रकाश m. N. of wk.
सं-वत्सर॑—प्रतिमा (˚र॑), f. the image of a y˚, TBr.
सं-वत्सर—प्रदीप m. N. of wk.
सं-वत्सर—प्रबर्ह and सं-वत्सर—प्रवल्ह, m. a variety of the Gavām-ayana (q.v.), Lāṭy.
सं-वत्सर—प्रबर्ह and सं-वत्सर—प्रवल्ह, m. a variety of the Gavām-ayana (q.v.), Lāṭy.
सं-वत्सर—प्रभृति mfn. lasting a y˚ and longer, KātyŚr.
सं-वत्सर—प्रवात mfn. exposed to the wind or air for a y˚, ĀpŚr.
सं-वत्सर—फल n. ‘the fruit or result of a year’, N. of wk.
सं-वत्सर—ब्राह्मण n. the symbolical meaning of an annual sacrifice, TāṇḍBr.
सं-वत्सर—भुक्ति f. a y˚'s course (of the sun), BhP.
सं-वत्सर—भृत् mfn. = -दीक्ष, Śulbas.
सं-वत्सर॑—भृत (˚र॑-), mfn. maintained for a year (cf. next), ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
सं-वत्सर—भृ˚तोख m. one who has borne the उखा (q.v.) for a year, ŚāṅkhŚr.
सं-वत्सर—भृतिन् mfn. one who has maintained (a sacrificial fire) for a year, KātyŚr.
सं-वत्सर—भ्रमि mfn. revolving or completing a revolution in a y˚ (as the sun), MārkP.
सं-वत्सर—मय mf(ई)n. consisting of (a partic. number of) y˚, Jyot.
सं-वत्सर—मुखी f. the tenth day in the light half of the month Jyaiṣṭha, Hcat.
सं-वत्सर—रय m. a year's course, MW.
सं-वत्सर—रूप॑ n. a form of the y˚, ŚBr.
सं-वत्सर—वासि॑न् mfn. dwelling (with a teacher) for a year, ib.
सं-वत्सर॑—विध (˚र॑-), mfn. (to be performed) according to the rules of an annual sacrifice, ib.
सं-वत्सर—वेला॑ f. the period of a year, ib.
सं-वत्सर—सत्त्र n. a Soma sacrifice whose Sutya days last a year, ŚāṅkhŚr.
सं-वत्सर—सत्त्र—भाष्य n. N. of wk.
सं-वत्सर—सत्त्र—स॑द् mfn. one who performs the above S˚ sacr˚, PS.; ŚBr.
सं-वत्सर॑—सम्मित (˚र॑-), mfn. equal to a y˚, ŚBr.
similar to the Sattra lasting a y˚, ŚāṅkhŚr.
सं-वत्सर॑—सम्मित n. and f(आ). N. of partic. sacrificial days (in the middle of which occurs the Viṣuvat-day), ŚrS.
सं-वत्सर—सहस्र॑ n. a thousand years, ŚBr.
सं-वत्सर॑—सात (˚र॑-), mf(आ)n. acquired with in a y˚, TS.
सं-वत्सर॑—स्वदित (˚र॑-), mfn. well seasoned or prepared for a y˚, ib.
संवत्सरात्यासम् ind. having skipped a y˚, Lāṭy.
संवत्सरादि-फल n. N. of wk.
सं-वत्सरान्तर्हित mfn. separated for a year, MaitrS.
संवत्सरा॑युष mfn. a year old, MaitrS.
संवत्सरावर mfn. lasting at least a year, KātyŚr.
संवत्सरोत्सव-कल्प-लता f. N. of wk.
संवत्सरोत्स˚व-काल-निर्णय m. N. of wk.
संवत्सरोपसत्क mfn. whose Upasad (q.v.) lasts a year, KātyŚr.
संवत्सरोपासित mfn. served or maintained for a year, ŚBr.
संवत्सरिक w.r. for सांव्˚.
सांवत्सरिक mfn. yearly, annual, relating to a year, produced in a year &c. (with बलि m. ‘annual revenue’; with रिण n. ‘a debt payable in a year’), AitBr. &c. &c.
relating to an annual sacrifice, Lāṭy.
सांवत्सरिक m. an astrologer, Pañcat.
संवत्सरी॑ण mf(आ)n. yearly, annual, recurring every year, RV.; &c.
संवत्सरी॑य mfn. id., MaitrS.
सांवत्सरीय mfn. = सांवत्सर above
सांवत्सरीया (ई), f. (with सिंनी) a partic. personification, IndSt.
सं-वदन n. the act of speaking together, conversation, Śaṃk.
a message, L.
consideration, examination, L.
(also, f(आ). ) subduing by charms or by magic (= or w.r. for सं-वनन, q.v.), L.
a charm, amulet, W.
सं-˚वादन n. (fr. id.) assent, agreement, Kathās.
सं-˚वदितव्य᳙ mfn. to be talked over or agreed upon, ŚBr.
to be spoken to or addressed.
सं-˚वादक mfn. (fr. Caus.) agreeing, consenting, Sāṃkhyak.
सं-˚वादक m. N. of a man, Hcar.
सं-वादाभिजयन n. obtaining the victory in disputes, Hir.
सं-˚वादित mfn. (fr. id.) caused to speak with &c.
agreed upon, MBh.
सं-˚वा˚दि-ता f. likeness, resemblance, Harav.
सं-˚वादिन् mfn. conversing, talking, Ragh.
agreeing or harmonizing with, corresponding to (gen. or comp.), Kāvyād.
सं-वादितृ mfn. holding a colloquy, HirP.
सं-˚वाद्य ind. (fr. Caus.) having declared truly or accurately, Mn. viii, 31.
सांवाद्य n. (fr. सं-वादिन्) g. ब्राह्मणादि.
सं-√ वन् Caus. -वानयति (or -वनयति cf. under √ वन्), to cause to like or love, make well-disposed, propitiate, AV.
सं-व॑नन mf(ई)n. propitiating, AV.
(ifc.) making well-disposed to (in दान-स्˚), R.
सं-व॑नन m. N. of an Āṅgirasa (author of RV. x, 191), Anukr.
सं-व॑नन n. or (आ), f. (cf. सं-वदन) causing mutual fondness, propitiating, subduing (esp. by spell), charming, fascination, AV. &c. &c.
सं-व॑नन m. gaining, acquiring (in कोश-स्˚), MBh.
सं-वनिन् mfn. concordant, Hir.
सं-√ वन्द् Ā. -वन्दते, to salute respectfully, BhP.

सं-√ 2. वप् cl. 1. P. Ā. -वपति, ˚ते, to throw together, mix, pour in VS.; TS.; ŚrS.;
to scatter, sow, MW.
सं-वपन n. throwing or pouring in KātyŚr.
सं-˚वाप m. throwing together, mixing, mingling, ĀpŚr., Sch.
सं-वर &c. See सं- √ 1. 2. वृ.
1. सं-वर mfn. keeping back, stopping (in काल-स्˚, applied to Viṣṇu), Pañcar.
सं-वर m. (often written and confounded with शम्बर) a dam, mound, bridge, Bhaṭṭ.
provisions, Divyāv.
shutting out the external world (with Jainas one of the 7 or 9 Tattvas), Sarvad.
N. of two Arhats, L.
सं-वर n. (with Buddhists) restraint, forbearance (or ‘a partic. religious observance’), Kāraṇḍ.
2. सं-वर m. choosing, election, choice (of v.l. for स्वयं-वर), MBh. vii, 6033.
सं-वार , ˚रण &c. See p. 1116, col. 1.
सं-वार m. (ifc. f(आ). ) covering, concealing, closing up, MW.
compression or contraction of the throat or of the vocal chords (in pronunciation), obtuse articulation (opp. to the वि-वार, q.v., and regarded as one of the Bāhya-prayatnas), Pāṇ. i, 1, 9, Sch.
an obstacle, impediment, Mṛcch. vii, (v.l.) 6/7
सं-वर्ग &c. See सं-√ वृज्
सं-वर्ग॑ mfn. rapacious, ravenous, RV.; ŚBr.; Up.; ŚrS.
सं-वर्ग॑ m. snatching up or sweeping together for one's self, gathering for one's self, TS.; Kāṭh. (with अग्नेः and प्रजापतेह् N. of Sāmans, ĀrṣBr.)
devouring, consumption, absorption, the resolution of one thing into another, MW.
(?) mixture, confusion (in वर्ण-स्˚), Vas.
multiplication of two numbers together or the product of such m˚, Āryabh.
सांवर्ग m. (fr. सं-वर्ग) N. of a Sāman (with इन्द्रस्य), ĀrṣBr.

सं-√ वर्ण् P. -वर्णयति, to communicate, narrate, tell, MBh.; Kathās.; BhP.;
to praise commend, approve, sanction, MBh.; SaddhP.; Divyāv.
सं-वर्णन n. narrating, describing, Cat.
praise, commendation, Jātakam.
सं-˚वर्णित mfn. communicated, narrated &c.
approved, sanctioned, Lalit.
resolute, ib.
सं-˚वर्णित—मानस mfn. one who has made up his mind, resolute, ib.
सं-वर्त ˚तक &c. See under सं-√ वृत्.
सं-वर्त॑ m. meeting, encountering (an enemy), MBh.
rolling up, destruction, (esp.) the periodical destruction or dissolution of the world, MBh.; R.; BhP.
a partic. cosmic period or Kalpa (q.v.), Cat.
anything rolled or kneaded, a lump or ball (of cake), Kauś.
a young rolled-up leaf, ĀpGṛ.
a dense mass (of people), Mālatīm.
a rain-cloud, R.; Hariv.
a partic. kind of cloud (abounding in water and so distinct from the Ā-varta which has no water; cf. द्रोण, पुष्कलोवर्तक), L.
N. of one of the 7 clouds at the dissolution of the universe (cf. भीमनाद), Cat.
a year, L.
a partic. mythical weapon, Hariv.; R.
a partic. comet, VarBṛS.
a partic. conjunction of planets, ib.
Terminalia Bellerica, L.
Cicer Arietinum, L.
N. of a Muni and legislator (cf. -स्मॄति and बृहत्-संव्˚), Yājñ.
of an Aṅgirasa (and author of RV. x, 172), AitBr. &c.
सं-वर्त॑ n. du. (with इन्द्रस्य) N. of two Sāmans, ĀrṣBr. (perhaps w.r. for सां-व्˚, q.v.)
सांवर्त mfn. written or composed by Saṃ-varta, Cat.
सांवर्त n. N. of various Sāmans (also with इन्द्रस्य), ĀrṣBr.
सं-वर्धक , ˚धन &c. See under सम्-√ वृध्.
सं-वर्धक mfn. augmenting, increasing, W.

सं-वर्मय Nom. P. ˚यति, to provide any one (acc.) with a coat of mail, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 25, Sch.;
to equip, arm, fully (fig.), Subh.
सं-वर्मित mfn. fully armed, W.
सं-वर्य Nom. P. ˚यति (usually written सम्बर्य), to bring together g. खोण्ड्वादि.
सं-˚वार्य mfn. to be covered or concealed (see संवृत्त-स्˚)
to be kept back or warded off (see अ-स्˚).
सं-वर्षण w.r. for अ-व्˚, Vet.
सं-वर्षण n. raining or showering down, MW.
सं-वल See शम्बल.
सं-वलन n. or ˚ना f. meeting, encountering (of enemies), Bālar.
mixture, union, Mālatīm.; Gīt.
सं-वलित mfn. met, united, joined or mixed with, surrounded by, possessed of (instr. or comp.), Kāv.; Sāh.
broken, diversified (= चूर्णित), Kir., vi, 4, Sch.
सं-√ वल्ग् Ā. -वल्गते, to wallow, roll, AV.; TS.
सं-वल्गन n. jumping (with joy), exulting, Anarghar.
सं-˚वल्गित mfn. overrun, MW.
सं-ववृत्वस् See सं-√ वृत्.
सं-ववृत्व॑स् mfn. (pf. p. of सं-√ वृत्) rolled up or together, gathered, dense (as darkness), RV. v, 31, 3.
सं-√ 4. वस् Ā. -वस्ते, to be clothed or clad in (instr.), RV. v, 85, 4.

सं-√ वाश् (only Intens. -वावशन्त, -अवावशिताम् and -वावशाना), to roar or cry together or at the same time, bellow, low, bleat, RV. :
Caus. -वाशयति, to cause to cry or low together, Lāṭy.
सं-वस्त्रण n. wearing the same or similar clothes, MānGṛ., Sch.

सं-वस्त्रय Nom. (fr. prec.) P. ˚यति (ind.p. -वस्त्र्य), to wear the same or similar garments, MānGṛ.;
to put on, wear, Bhaṭṭ.
1. सं-वासिन् mfn. (ifc.) clothed in MBh.
2. सं-वासिन् mfn. dwelling together, a fellow-dweller, Kām.; Rājat.
(ifc.) dwelling in, inhabiting, MBh.; R.
सं-वसति f. dwelling together, Subh.
सं-˚वसथ m. an inhabited place, settlement, village, dwelling, house, KāśīKh.
सं-˚व॑सन n. a dwelling place, house, RV.
सं-˚व॑सान m. = next, RV.
सं॑-वसु m. one who dwells along with, a fellow-dweller, RV.; AV.
सं-वास m. dwelling together, living or associating with (instr. with and without सह, or comp.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
cohabitation, sexual connexion with (comp.), Car.
a common abode, Kām.
a settlement, dwelling, house, MBh.; R. &c.
an open place for meeting or recreation, L.
association, company, society, W.

सं-वह m. ‘bearing or carrying along’, N. of the wind of the third of the 7 Mārgas or paths of the sky (that which is above the उद्-वह and impels the moon; the other five winds being called आ-, प्र-, वि-, परि-, and नि-वह), MBh.; Hariv. &c.
N. of one of the 7 tongues of fire, Col.
सं-वाह mfn. setting in motion, moving (see तृण-स्˚)
= सं-वाहक, L.
सं-वाह m. bearing or carrying along, pressing together, MW.
rubbing the body, shampooing, MārkP.
a park for recreation (cf. सं-वास), MBh.; Hariv.
a market-place, Pat., Sch.
extortion oppression, Rājat.
N. of one of the 7 winds (= or w.r. for सं-वह above), L.
सं-वाह &c. See सं-√ वह्.
सं-˚वहन n. guiding, conducting, Suśr.
showing, displaying, Kuval.
सं-˚वाहन n. (fr. id.) bearing, carrying, driving &c., MBh.
the moving along or passage (of clouds), Mālatīm.
rubbing the person, shampooing, Suśr.; Kāv.; Kathās.
सं-˚वहितृ See सांवहित्र.
सं-˚वाहक mf(इका)n. (fr. Caus.) one who rubs or shampoos the limb
सं-˚वाहक m. a shampooer, R.; Mṛcch. &c.
सं-˚वाहितव्य mfn. (fr. id.) to be rubbed or stroked, MBh.
सं-˚वाहिन् mfn. leading, conducting
सं-˚वाहिनी (इनी), f. a partic. vessel of the body (leading from the fetus to the mother), Car.
सं-˚वाह्य mfn. to be borne or carried &c., Pañcat.
to be rubbed or kneaded, W.
to be shown or betrayed (अस्˚), Kpr.
सं-वोढृ See Pāṇ. iv, 3, 120, Vārtt. 8, Pat.
सं-वोढृ See सं-√ वह्.
सं-√ वाञ्छ् P. -वाञ्छति, to long for, wish, desire, Bhaṭṭ.
संवाटिका f. the aquatic plant Trapa Bispinosa, L.
सं-वाध √ वाध् incorrect for सम्बाध, q.v.
सं-वावदूक mfn. agreeing, consenting, Anarghar.
सं-वासित mfn. (√ वास्) made fragrant, perfumed, MW.
made fetid, having an offensive smell (said of the breath), Suśr.
सं-विक्त w.r. for सं-वित्क, NṛsUp.
सं-विघ्नित mfn. impeded, hindered, prevented, Amar.
सं-वि-√ चिन्त् P. -चिन्तयति, to consider fully, meditate or reflect upon, BhP.
सं-वि-चेतव्य mfn. (√ 2. चि cf. वि-चेतव्य, p. 959) to be entirely separated or kept apart, R.

सं-√ वीज् Caus. -वीजयति, to fan, BhP.;
to cause (the hair of the body) to stand erect, Car.
सं-विग्न mfn. agitated, flurried, terrified, shy, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
moving to and fro, BhP.
(ifc.) fallen into, ib.
सं-विग्न—मानस mfn. agitated or distracted in mind, MBh.
सं-वेग m. violent agitation, excitement, flurry, MBh.; Kathās.
vehemence, intensity, high degree, Uttarar.; Rājat.
desire of emancipation, HPariś.
सं-वेग , सं-वेजन. See सं-√ विज्.
सं-वेग—धारिणी f. N. of a Kiṃ-narī, Kāraṇḍ.
सं-वेजन See नेत्र- and रोम-स्˚.
सं-वेजन See सं-√ विज्.
सं-वेजनीय mfn. to be agitated, tending to agitate the mind violently, Jātakam.
सं-विज्ञात mfn. generally known, agreeing with (in अ-स्˚).
सं-विज्ञान n. agreement, consent, Suśr.
